SQL
SELECT
	[IEP Activity Key],
	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '31/11/2021'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '31/11/2021'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END														AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA_MANUAL PYMT
ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
AND '2021-12-01' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

WHERE PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN') 
AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU','APPR','RECR','RCFU','RCPU')

AND PYMT.StatusDateTime IS NOT NULL

AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  /* data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.*/

)A
GROUP BY [IEP Activity Key],[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],[IEP Activity Extract Date],[IEP Activity ID],Payment_FY

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/CDP_Contract_Refe.original_load:
[CDP_Contract_Referral_Placement]:
LOAD
	[CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date],
    [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key],
    [Contract Referral Job Seeker Id],
    [Contract Referral Placement Status],
    [ROW_NUM],
    [Current Caseload Flag],
    'Yes'	AS [Current Contract Placement Flag],
    1		AS [CDP Contract Referral Placement Row Counter]
WHERE ROW_NUM = 1
;select DISTINCT
	'30/11/2024'														as [CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date],
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CRP.JobSeekerId) + '|'
    	+ '30/11/2024'													as [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key],
	CRP.JobSeekerId															as [Contract Referral Job Seeker Id],
	YSP.LONG_DESC															as [Contract Referral Placement Status],
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRP.JobSeekerId,CRP.PlacementDate,CRP.PlacementTypeCode
        						ORDER BY CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC)		AS [ROW_NUM],
	CASE
    	WHEN CRP.StatusCode IN ('COM','PND','SUS') THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END																		as [Current Caseload Flag]	
from ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA CRP
LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YSP
ON CRP.StatusCode = YSP.Code
AND YSP.FK_CDT_CODE = 'YSP'
WHERE '2024-11-30' BETWEEN CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND CRP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND CRP.JobSeekerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerId FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_Project_Placement_HISTORY_NIAA)
AND CRP.ContractTypeCode = 'RJCP'

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/CDP_Job_Seeker_20.original_load:
[CDP_Job_Seeker]:
SELECT DISTINCT
	JS.[EXTRACT_DATE]						as [CDP Job Seeker Extract Date]
	,'30/11/2024'						as [CDP Job Seeker Snapshot Date]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '30/11/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '30/11/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '30/11/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '30/11/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to JSCI Key]
	,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID] 						as [Job Seeker ID]
	,[CRN] 
	,[BIRTH_DATE]							as [Birth Date]
    ,JS.GENDER_CD							AS [Gender Code]
	,GDR.Long_Desc							as [Gender]
	,ISNULL([GIVEN_NAME] + ' ','')
    	+ [SURNAME]							as [Job Seeker Name]
	,[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD]				AS [Residential Community Code]
	,COALESCE(ccd.LONG_DESC,'UKN')			as [Residential Community]
	,[POSTAL_COMMUNITY_CD]					AS [Postal Community Code]
	,COALESCE(ccd_p.LONG_DESC,'UKN')		as [Postal Community]
    ,case
    	when (JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] is null or JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] = 'UNK') then COALESCE(ccd.LONG_DESC,'UKN')
    	else COALESCE(ccd_p.LONG_DESC,'UKN')
     end 									as [Job Seeker Community Name]

	,jsc.INDIGENOUS_IND 					AS [Indigenous Flag]
FROM [ESS].[SUB814_JOBSEEKER_NIAA] JS

LEFT JOIN ESS.DIM_GENDER GDR
  ON JS.GENDER_CD = GDR.GENDER_CD

LEFT JOIN ess.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ccd
  ON js.RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD = ccd.CODE
  AND ccd.FK_CDT_CODE = 'CCD'

LEFT JOIN ess.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ccd_p
  ON js.POSTAL_COMMUNITY_CD = ccd_p.CODE
  AND ccd_p.FK_CDT_CODE = 'CCD'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB837_CDP_DEN_JS_CHARACTERISTICS_NIAA jsc
  ON JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID = jsc.JOB_SEEKER_ID /*AR.FK_CVF_JSKR_ID*/ 
  AND '2024-11-30' BETWEEN jsc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND jsc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

where '2024-11-30' BETWEEN js.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND js.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerId
						FROM ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA
						WHERE ContractTypeCode = 'RJCP')

[IEP_Activity_Expenditure]:
SELECT
	[IEP Activity Key],
	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '30/11/2024'												AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '30/11/2024'								    				AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE														AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)										AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END																	AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END																	AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END																	AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END																	AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END																	AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END																	AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END																	AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA PYMT
ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
AND '2024-11-30' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

WHERE PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN') 
AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU','APPR','RECR','RCFU','RCPU')

AND PYMT.StatusDateTime IS NOT NULL
AND '2024-11-30'  BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  /* data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.*/

)A
GROUP BY [IEP Activity Key],[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],[IEP Activity Extract Date],[IEP Activity ID],Payment_FY
--order by [IEP Activity ID]
--END

SQL
SELECT
	[IEP Placement Key],
    [Placement Final Milestone Date],
	[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
	[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
	[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week],
	CASE WHEN [Placement Max Paid Outcome Week] >= 26
	THEN 'Y'
	ELSE 'N' END AS [Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
FROM
(
SELECT 
[IEP Placement Key],
 MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
 MAX([Placement Paid Outcome Week])	   AS [Placement Max Paid Outcome Week],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
 
 from
 (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    + '30/11/2024'							AS [IEP Placement Key],   
	CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,OC.Week,COALESCE(PP.commencementDate,PP.Enddate)) AS DATE) as MilestoneDate,
   CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 
	    CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,13,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
		ELSE NULL END AS [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 
	    CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,26,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
		ELSE NULL END AS [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
	OC.Week				AS [Placement Paid Outcome Week],
	CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN      --- ANYTHING GREATER THAN 26 WEEKS IS COUNTED AS 26 WEEKS.
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=52 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=104 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

 )
 a

    CASE WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
		      CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
			  ELSE  
			  CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			  END AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],

    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     THEN 1
     ELSE 0 END  AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
     COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
     CASE WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T')

	   END AS [Placement Training Commencements],
     CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	 CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2024-11-30' THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2024-11-30' 
             OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2024-11-30'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 THEN  PP.JobSeekerId

			         END

			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
     CASE WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01' 
	      THEN 'Y' 
		  ELSE 'N'
		  END AS [IAS Placement Flag],
          
		CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-11-30') THEN  --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-11-30') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-11-30')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 THEN PP.JobSeekerId
					 ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         END  
			 ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as [Placement Active As of Prev Period]   -- as of same date previous year,
       ,COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') as [Placement Result Desc]
// 	   ,[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week]
// 	   ,[Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome]
// 	   ,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]
// 	   ,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]
// 	   ,[Placement Final Milestone Date]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]
FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG
ON PP.PlacementGroupId = PG.PlacementGroupId
AND '2024-11-30' BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P
ON PP.ProjectId=P.ProjectId
AND '2024-11-30' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA PGS
ON PG.CategoryCode = PGS.CODE
AND PGS.FK_CDT_CODE = 'PGS'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA IIN
ON PP.IndustryCode = IIN.CODE
AND IIN.FK_CDT_CODE = 'IIN'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJ
ON PP.OccupationCode = AZJ.CODE
AND AZJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA IINold
ON PP.IndustryCodeOld = IINold.CODE
AND IINold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'IIN'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJold
ON PP.OccupationCodeOld = AZJold.CODE
AND AZJold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YEP
ON PP.EndReason = YEP.CODE
AND YEP.FK_CDT_CODE = 'YEP'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA RRU
ON PP.PlacementResultCode = RRU.CODE
AND RRU.FK_CDT_CODE = 'RRU'

WHERE '2024-11-30' BETWEEN PP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND PP.PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X','T')
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  --// data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/CDP_Contract_Refe.original_load:
[CDP_Contract_Referral_Placement]:
LOAD
	[CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date],
    [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key],
    [Contract Referral Job Seeker Id],
    [Contract Referral Placement Status],
    [ROW_NUM],
    [Current Caseload Flag],
    'Yes'	AS [Current Contract Placement Flag],
    1		AS [CDP Contract Referral Placement Row Counter]
WHERE ROW_NUM = 1
;select DISTINCT
	'31/12/2024'														as [CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date],
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CRP.JobSeekerId) + '|'
    	+ '31/12/2024'													as [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key],
	CRP.JobSeekerId															as [Contract Referral Job Seeker Id],
	YSP.LONG_DESC															as [Contract Referral Placement Status],
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRP.JobSeekerId,CRP.PlacementDate,CRP.PlacementTypeCode
        						ORDER BY CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC)		AS [ROW_NUM],
	CASE
    	WHEN CRP.StatusCode IN ('COM','PND','SUS') THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END																		as [Current Caseload Flag]	
from ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA CRP
LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YSP
ON CRP.StatusCode = YSP.Code
AND YSP.FK_CDT_CODE = 'YSP'
WHERE '2024-12-31' BETWEEN CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND CRP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND CRP.JobSeekerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerId FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_Project_Placement_HISTORY_NIAA)
AND CRP.ContractTypeCode = 'RJCP'

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/CDP_Job_Seeker_20.original_load:
[CDP_Job_Seeker]:
SELECT DISTINCT
	JS.[EXTRACT_DATE]						as [CDP Job Seeker Extract Date]
	,'31/12/2024'						as [CDP Job Seeker Snapshot Date]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '31/12/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '31/12/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '31/12/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '31/12/2024'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to JSCI Key]
	,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID] 						as [Job Seeker ID]
	,[CRN] 
	,[BIRTH_DATE]							as [Birth Date]
    ,JS.GENDER_CD							AS [Gender Code]
	,GDR.Long_Desc							as [Gender]
	,ISNULL([GIVEN_NAME] + ' ','')
    	+ [SURNAME]							as [Job Seeker Name]
	,[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD]				AS [Residential Community Code]
	,COALESCE(ccd.LONG_DESC,'UKN')			as [Residential Community]
	,[POSTAL_COMMUNITY_CD]					AS [Postal Community Code]
	,COALESCE(ccd_p.LONG_DESC,'UKN')		as [Postal Community]
    ,case
    	when (JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] is null or JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] = 'UNK') then COALESCE(ccd.LONG_DESC,'UKN')
    	else COALESCE(ccd_p.LONG_DESC,'UKN')
     end 									as [Job Seeker Community Name]

	,jsc.INDIGENOUS_IND 					AS [Indigenous Flag]
FROM [ESS].[SUB814_JOBSEEKER_NIAA] JS

LEFT JOIN ESS.DIM_GENDER GDR
  ON JS.GENDER_CD = GDR.GENDER_CD

LEFT JOIN ess.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ccd
  ON js.RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD = ccd.CODE
  AND ccd.FK_CDT_CODE = 'CCD'

LEFT JOIN ess.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ccd_p
  ON js.POSTAL_COMMUNITY_CD = ccd_p.CODE
  AND ccd_p.FK_CDT_CODE = 'CCD'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB837_CDP_DEN_JS_CHARACTERISTICS_NIAA jsc
  ON JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID = jsc.JOB_SEEKER_ID /*AR.FK_CVF_JSKR_ID*/ 
  AND '2024-12-31' BETWEEN jsc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND jsc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

where '2024-12-31' BETWEEN js.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND js.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerId
						FROM ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA
						WHERE ContractTypeCode = 'RJCP')

[IEP_Activity]:
SQL
SELECT DISTINCT
CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
+ '31/12/2024'									AS [IEP Activity Key],
'31/12/2024'									AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE									AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
P.ProjectId											AS [IEP Activity ID],
CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProviderId) + '|ESSWEB|'
+ '31/12/2024'									AS [IEP Provider Key],
P.Title												As [Activity Name],
	
CONVERT(DATE,StartDate)								AS [Activity Start Date],
EndDate												AS [Activity End Date],
SupervisingOfficeCode								AS [Supervising Office Code],
ISNULL(DIS.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Supervising Office],
ApprovalDate										AS [Activity Approved Date],
ApprovedCost										AS [Activity Approved Cost],
ProgramCategoryCode									AS [Program CAT Code],
p.StatusCode										AS [Activity Status Code],
ISA.LONG_DESC										AS [Activity Status],
ApprovedCost - UnspentFunds							AS [Activity Spent Funds],
UnspentFunds										AS [Activity Unspent Funds],
CONCAT(USR.FIRST_GIVEN_NAME, ' ' ,USR.FAMILY_NAME)  AS [Activity Contract Manager],
USR.EMAIL_ADDRESS									AS [Activity Contract Manager Email],
CONCAT(BDO.FIRST_GIVEN_NAME, ' ' ,BDO.FAMILY_NAME)  AS [Business Development Officer],
BDO.EMAIL_ADDRESS									AS [Business Development Officer Email],
ExecutionDate										AS [Legal Contract Execution Date],
MaxTrainingCount									AS [Activity Training Max Places],
MaxEmploymentCount									AS [Activity Employment Max Places],
Description											AS [Activity Description],
RecruitmentEndDate									AS [Activity Recruitment End Date],
	CASE WHEN RecruitmentEndDate > '2024-12-31' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END
													AS [Activity Recruitment Ended Flag],
	prg.[IEP Program Element],
	prg.[IEP Program Name],

	P.TypeCode											AS [Project Type Code],

FLOOR(DATEDIFF(day,StartDate,EndDate)/7)			AS [Activity Duration (Weeks)],

	COALESCE(COALESCE(OC1.LONG_DESC,OC1old.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Industry],
COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Occupation]
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA PRJ
			WHERE PRJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'PRJ') PRJ
ON P.TypeCode = PRJ.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ISA
			WHERE ISA.FK_CDT_CODE = 'ISA') ISA
ON P.StatusCode = ISA.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA DIS
			WHERE DIS.FK_CDT_CODE = 'DIS') DIS
ON P.SupervisingOfficeCode = DIS.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA OC1
			WHERE OC1.FK_CDT_CODE = 'OC1') OC1
ON P.IndustryCode = OC1.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJ
			WHERE AZJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ') AZJ
ON P.OccupationCode = AZJ.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA OC1old
			WHERE OC1old.FK_CDT_CODE = 'OC1') OC1old
ON P.IndustryCodeOld = OC1old.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJold
			WHERE AZJold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ') AZJold
ON P.OccupationCodeOld = AZJold.CODE

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT ESS_USER_ID,
					FIRST_GIVEN_NAME,
					FAMILY_NAME,
					EMAIL_ADDRESS,
					ESS_ACTIVE_FLAG,
					usr.CREATED_ON,
					RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ESS_USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_ON DESC) rnk
			FROM ESS.SUB863_EBIW_ESAM_USERS_NIAA USR
WHERE ORG = 'NNEF'
			) USR
ON P.ContractManager = USR.ESS_USER_ID
AND USR.rnk = 1

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT ESS_USER_ID,
					FIRST_GIVEN_NAME,
					FAMILY_NAME,
					EMAIL_ADDRESS,
					ESS_ACTIVE_FLAG,
					usr.CREATED_ON,
					RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ESS_USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_ON DESC) rnk
			FROM ESS.SUB863_EBIW_ESAM_USERS_NIAA USR
WHERE ORG = 'NNEF'
			) BDO
ON P.BusinessDevelopmentOfficer = BDO.ESS_USER_ID
AND BDO.rnk = 1

LEFT JOIN ESS.[IEP Program Element] prg
ON P.ProjectId = prg.[IEP Activity ID]

WHERE '2024-12-31' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782) || [IEP_Activity_Original_Approval]:

--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '31/12/2024'												AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '31/12/2024'								    				AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE														AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)										AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END																	AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END																	AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END																	AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END																	AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END																	AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END																	AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END																	AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA PYMT
ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
AND '2024-12-31' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

WHERE PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN') 
AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU','APPR','RECR','RCFU','RCPU')

AND PYMT.StatusDateTime IS NOT NULL
AND '2024-12-31'  BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  /* data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.*/

)A
GROUP BY [IEP Activity Key],[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],[IEP Activity Extract Date],[IEP Activity ID],Payment_FY
--order by [IEP Activity ID]
--END

	CASE WHEN [Placement Max Paid Outcome Week] >= 26

	[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],

 MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
 MAX([Placement Paid Outcome Week])	   AS [Placement Max Paid Outcome Week],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
 
 from
 (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    + '31/12/2024'							AS [IEP Placement Key],   
	CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,OC.Week,COALESCE(PP.commencementDate,PP.Enddate)) AS DATE) as MilestoneDate,
   CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 
	    CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,13,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
		ELSE NULL END AS [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 
	    CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,26,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
		ELSE NULL END AS [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
	OC.Week				AS [Placement Paid Outcome Week],
	CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN      --- ANYTHING GREATER THAN 26 WEEKS IS COUNTED AS 26 WEEKS.
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=52 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=104 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

    PP.CreatedOn										AS [Placement Creation Date],
    CommencementDate									AS [Placement Start Date],
    CASE WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
		      CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
			  ELSE  
			  CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			  END AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],

    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE

     ELSE 0 END  AS [Employment Commenced],

     CASE WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T')

	   ELSE 0 
	   END AS [Placement Training Commencements],
     CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	 CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2024-12-31' THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2024-12-31' 
             OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2024-12-31'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active.

			         END

			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
     CASE WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01'

		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-12-31') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-12-31')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE

			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as [Placement Active As of Prev Period]   -- as of same date previous year,
       ,COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') as [Placement Result Desc]

[IEP_Activity_Expenditure]:
SQL
SELECT
	[IEP Activity Key],
	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '20/11/2022'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '20/11/2022'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END														AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA PYMT
ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
AND '2022-11-20' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

WHERE PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN') 
AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU','APPR','RECR','RCFU','RCPU')

AND PYMT.StatusDateTime IS NOT NULL
AND '2022-11-20' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  /* data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.*/

)A

IEP_Claim_Payments:
Load
    [IEP Activity Key],
    [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
    [IEP Payment Extract Date],
    [IEP Payment Key],
    [IEP Payment Activity ID],
    PaymentId as [Payment ID], // Claim ID = Payment ID
    Payment_FY,
    Expenditure,
    Advance,
    Acquittal,
    Expenditure_GST_Free,
    Advance_GST_Free, 
    Acquittal_GST_Free,
    Expenditure + Advance + Expenditure_GST_Free + Advance_GST_Free as [Total Expenditure],
    (Expenditure/1.1) + (Advance/1.1) + Expenditure_GST_Free + Advance_GST_Free as [Total Expenditure GST Excl],
    Advance + Advance_GST_Free as [Advance Paid],
    (Advance/1.1) + Advance_GST_Free as [Advance Paid GST Excl],
    Date(Due_Date) as Due_Date,
    Month(Due_Date) & '-' & Year(Due_Date) as [Payment Month Year],
    StatusCode,
    PaymentType;SQL
SELECT
   [IEP Activity Key],
   [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
   [IEP Payment Extract Date],
   [IEP Payment Key],
   [IEP Payment Activity ID], 
   PaymentId,
   CASE WHEN MONTH(Due_Date) <= 6 THEN
        CAST(YEAR(Due_Date) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(Due_Date) AS varchar(4) ) 
        ELSE
        CAST(YEAR(Due_Date) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(Due_Date) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
        END AS Payment_FY,
   Payments as Expenditure,
   Advance as Advance,
   Acquittal as Acquittal,
   Payments_GST_Free as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
   Advance_GST_Free as Advance_GST_Free, 
   Acquittal_GST_Free as Acquittal_GST_Free,   

   Due_Date,
   StatusCode,
   PaymentType
from
(SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|' 
		+ '20/11/2022'						AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '20/11/2022'								AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.EXTRACT_DATE,103)			    					AS [IEP Payment Extract Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PYMT.PaymentId) + '|' 
		+ '20/11/2022'						AS [IEP Payment Key],
    CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC) 									AS [IEP Payment Activity ID],
    CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
          WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
          ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END AS Payments

    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
        THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
       ELSE 0
      END AS Acquittal

    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
        THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0 
        END AS Advance

    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
          WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
          ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
      END AS Payments_GST_Free

    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
        THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
       ELSE 0
      END AS Acquittal_GST_Free
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
        THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0 
        END AS Advance_GST_Free

    ,PYMT.PaymentId
    ,CAST(COALESCE(case when pymt.Duedate='0001-01-01' then NULL else pymt.DueDate end, pymt.StatusDateTime) AS DATE) AS Due_Date
    ,PYMT.PaymentType
    ,PYMT.StatusCode
    ,PYMT.StatusDateTime

    FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   
    LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA PYMT
        ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
        AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
        AND '2022-11-20' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

    WHERE P.[ProgramCategoryCode]='A20'    
    AND PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN') 
    AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU','APPR','RECR','RCFU','RCPU')

    AND PYMT.StatusDateTime IS NOT NULL
    AND '2022-11-20' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   
    AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  
	)A

SQL
SELECT * 
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		[IEP Placement Key],
 		MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 		MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
 
 	from
    (
		SELECT 
 		CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    		+ '20/11/2022'							AS [IEP Placement Key],   
		CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,OC.Week,COALESCE(PP.commencementDate,PP.Enddate)) AS DATE) as MilestoneDate,
   		CASE
        	WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,13,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
			ELSE NULL END 													AS [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 
	        CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,26,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
            ELSE NULL END 													AS [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
		CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 1
			ELSE 0 END 														AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 1     --- ANYTHING GREATER THAN 26 WEEKS IS COUNTED AS 26 WEEKS.
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=52 THEN 1
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=104 THEN 1
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

    '20/11/2022'								AS [IEP Placement Snapshot Date],
	PP.EXTRACT_DATE										AS [IEP Placement Extract Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    + '20/11/2022'							AS [IEP Placement Key],
    PP.ProjectPlacementId								AS [IEP Placement ID],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectId) + '|'
    + '20/11/2022'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobSeekerId) + '|'
    + '20/11/2022'							AS [IEP Job Seeker Key],
    PP.CreatedOn										AS [Placement Creation Date],
    CommencementDate									AS [Placement Start Date],
    CASE 
    	WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
			CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
        ELSE  
        	CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
    END 												AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],
    PlacementDescription								AS [Placement Description],
    EmployerABN											AS [Placement Employer ABN],
    NotionalFullTime									AS [Placement Notional Full Time],
    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],
    Locality											AS [Placement Locality],
    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     	WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     	THEN 1
     	ELSE 0
    END  												AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
    COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')					AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
    CASE
    	WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T') 
	   	THEN 1 
	   	ELSE 0 
    END 												AS [Placement Training Commencements],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         											AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2022-11-20'
        	THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   		CASE
                	WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2022-11-20' 
             			OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             		THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
						CASE
                        	WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2022-11-20'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     		THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     		WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 		THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 		ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         	END  
			 		ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
				END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
            END											as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
    CASE
     	WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01' 
        THEN 'Y' 
        ELSE 'N'
  	END 												AS [IAS Placement Flag],
          
    CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2022-11-20')
        THEN  --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
			CASE
           		WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2022-11-20') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL
            	THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
					CASE
                		WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2022-11-20')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
                	END  
            	ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
		ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
	END													as [Placement Active As of Prev Period],   -- as of same date previous year,
    COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') 					as [Placement Result Desc]
	   --,[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week]
	   --,[Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome]
	   --,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Placement Final Milestone Date]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]
FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG
ON PP.PlacementGroupId = PG.PlacementGroupId
AND '2022-11-20' BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/CDP_Contract_Refe.original_load:
[CDP_Contract_Referral_Placement]:
LOAD
	[CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date],
    [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key],
    [Contract Referral Job Seeker Id],
    [Contract Referral Placement Status],
    [ROW_NUM],
    [Current Caseload Flag],
    'Yes'	AS [Current Contract Placement Flag],
    1		AS [CDP Contract Referral Placement Row Counter]
WHERE ROW_NUM = 1
;select DISTINCT
	'31/03/2024'														as [CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date],
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CRP.JobSeekerId) + '|'
    	+ '31/03/2024'													as [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key],
	CRP.JobSeekerId															as [Contract Referral Job Seeker Id],
	YSP.LONG_DESC															as [Contract Referral Placement Status],
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRP.JobSeekerId,CRP.PlacementDate,CRP.PlacementTypeCode
        						ORDER BY CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE DESC)		AS [ROW_NUM],
	CASE
    	WHEN CRP.StatusCode IN ('COM','PND','SUS') THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END																		as [Current Caseload Flag]	
from ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA CRP
LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YSP
ON CRP.StatusCode = YSP.Code
AND YSP.FK_CDT_CODE = 'YSP'
WHERE '2024-03-31' BETWEEN CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND CRP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND CRP.JobSeekerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerId FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_Project_Placement_HISTORY_NIAA)
AND CRP.ContractTypeCode = 'RJCP'

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/IEP_Activity_2024.original_load:
[IEP_Activity]:
SQL
SELECT DISTINCT
CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
+ '31/03/2024'									AS [IEP Activity Key],
'31/03/2024'									AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE									AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
P.ProjectId											AS [IEP Activity ID],
CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProviderId) + '|ESSWEB|'
+ '31/03/2024'									AS [IEP Provider Key],
P.Title												As [Activity Name],
	
CONVERT(DATE,StartDate)								AS [Activity Start Date],
EndDate												AS [Activity End Date],
SupervisingOfficeCode								AS [Supervising Office Code],
ISNULL(DIS.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Supervising Office],
ApprovalDate										AS [Activity Approved Date],
ApprovedCost										AS [Activity Approved Cost],
ProgramCategoryCode									AS [Program CAT Code],
p.StatusCode										AS [Activity Status Code],
ISA.LONG_DESC										AS [Activity Status],
ApprovedCost - UnspentFunds							AS [Activity Spent Funds],
UnspentFunds										AS [Activity Unspent Funds],
CONCAT(USR.FIRST_GIVEN_NAME, ' ' ,USR.FAMILY_NAME)  AS [Activity Contract Manager],
USR.EMAIL_ADDRESS									AS [Activity Contract Manager Email],
CONCAT(BDO.FIRST_GIVEN_NAME, ' ' ,BDO.FAMILY_NAME)  AS [Business Development Officer],
BDO.EMAIL_ADDRESS									AS [Business Development Officer Email],
ExecutionDate										AS [Legal Contract Execution Date],
MaxTrainingCount									AS [Activity Training Max Places],
MaxEmploymentCount									AS [Activity Employment Max Places],
Description											AS [Activity Description],
RecruitmentEndDate									AS [Activity Recruitment End Date],
	CASE WHEN RecruitmentEndDate > '2024-03-31' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END
													AS [Activity Recruitment Ended Flag],
	prg.[IEP Program Element],
	prg.[IEP Program Name],

	P.TypeCode											AS [Project Type Code],

FLOOR(DATEDIFF(day,StartDate,EndDate)/7)			AS [Activity Duration (Weeks)],

	COALESCE(COALESCE(OC1.LONG_DESC,OC1old.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Industry],
COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Occupation]
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA PRJ
			WHERE PRJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'PRJ') PRJ
ON P.TypeCode = PRJ.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ISA
			WHERE ISA.FK_CDT_CODE = 'ISA') ISA
ON P.StatusCode = ISA.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA DIS
			WHERE DIS.FK_CDT_CODE = 'DIS') DIS
ON P.SupervisingOfficeCode = DIS.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA OC1
			WHERE OC1.FK_CDT_CODE = 'OC1') OC1
ON P.IndustryCode = OC1.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJ
			WHERE AZJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ') AZJ
ON P.OccupationCode = AZJ.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA OC1old
			WHERE OC1old.FK_CDT_CODE = 'OC1') OC1old
ON P.IndustryCodeOld = OC1old.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJold
			WHERE AZJold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ') AZJold
ON P.OccupationCodeOld = AZJold.CODE

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT ESS_USER_ID,
					FIRST_GIVEN_NAME,
					FAMILY_NAME,
					EMAIL_ADDRESS,
					ESS_ACTIVE_FLAG,
					usr.CREATED_ON,
					RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ESS_USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_ON DESC) rnk
			FROM ESS.SUB863_EBIW_ESAM_USERS_NIAA USR
WHERE ORG = 'NNEF'
			) USR
ON P.ContractManager = USR.ESS_USER_ID
AND USR.rnk = 1

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT ESS_USER_ID,
					FIRST_GIVEN_NAME,
					FAMILY_NAME,
					EMAIL_ADDRESS,
					ESS_ACTIVE_FLAG,
					usr.CREATED_ON,
					RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ESS_USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_ON DESC) rnk
			FROM ESS.SUB863_EBIW_ESAM_USERS_NIAA USR
WHERE ORG = 'NNEF'
			) BDO
ON P.BusinessDevelopmentOfficer = BDO.ESS_USER_ID
AND BDO.rnk = 1

LEFT JOIN ESS.[IEP Program Element] prg
ON P.ProjectId = prg.[IEP Activity ID]

SELECT DISTINCT
CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
+ '31/10/2024'									AS [IEP Activity Key],
'31/10/2024'									AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE									AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
P.ProjectId											AS [IEP Activity ID],
CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProviderId) + '|ESSWEB|'
+ '31/10/2024'									AS [IEP Provider Key],
P.Title												As [Activity Name],
	
CONVERT(DATE,StartDate)								AS [Activity Start Date],
EndDate												AS [Activity End Date],
SupervisingOfficeCode								AS [Supervising Office Code],
ISNULL(DIS.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Supervising Office],
ApprovalDate										AS [Activity Approved Date],
ApprovedCost										AS [Activity Approved Cost],
ProgramCategoryCode									AS [Program CAT Code],
p.StatusCode										AS [Activity Status Code],
ISA.LONG_DESC										AS [Activity Status],
ApprovedCost - UnspentFunds							AS [Activity Spent Funds],
UnspentFunds										AS [Activity Unspent Funds],
CONCAT(USR.FIRST_GIVEN_NAME, ' ' ,USR.FAMILY_NAME)  AS [Activity Contract Manager],
USR.EMAIL_ADDRESS									AS [Activity Contract Manager Email],
CONCAT(BDO.FIRST_GIVEN_NAME, ' ' ,BDO.FAMILY_NAME)  AS [Business Development Officer],
BDO.EMAIL_ADDRESS									AS [Business Development Officer Email],
ExecutionDate										AS [Legal Contract Execution Date],
MaxTrainingCount									AS [Activity Training Max Places],
MaxEmploymentCount									AS [Activity Employment Max Places],
Description											AS [Activity Description],
RecruitmentEndDate									AS [Activity Recruitment End Date],
	CASE WHEN RecruitmentEndDate > '2024-10-31' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END
													AS [Activity Recruitment Ended Flag],
	prg.[IEP Program Element],
	prg.[IEP Program Name],

	P.TypeCode											AS [Project Type Code],

FLOOR(DATEDIFF(day,StartDate,EndDate)/7)			AS [Activity Duration (Weeks)],

	COALESCE(COALESCE(OC1.LONG_DESC,OC1old.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Industry],
COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Occupation]
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA PRJ
			WHERE PRJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'PRJ') PRJ
ON P.TypeCode = PRJ.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ISA
			WHERE ISA.FK_CDT_CODE = 'ISA') ISA
ON P.StatusCode = ISA.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA DIS
			WHERE DIS.FK_CDT_CODE = 'DIS') DIS
ON P.SupervisingOfficeCode = DIS.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA OC1
			WHERE OC1.FK_CDT_CODE = 'OC1') OC1
ON P.IndustryCode = OC1.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJ
			WHERE AZJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ') AZJ
ON P.OccupationCode = AZJ.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA OC1old
			WHERE OC1old.FK_CDT_CODE = 'OC1') OC1old
ON P.IndustryCodeOld = OC1old.CODE

LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJold
			WHERE AZJold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ') AZJold
ON P.OccupationCodeOld = AZJold.CODE

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT ESS_USER_ID,
					FIRST_GIVEN_NAME,
					FAMILY_NAME,
					EMAIL_ADDRESS,
					ESS_ACTIVE_FLAG,
					usr.CREATED_ON,
					RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ESS_USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_ON DESC) rnk
			FROM ESS.SUB863_EBIW_ESAM_USERS_NIAA USR
WHERE ORG = 'NNEF'
			) USR
ON P.ContractManager = USR.ESS_USER_ID
AND USR.rnk = 1

			SELECT ESS_USER_ID,
					FIRST_GIVEN_NAME,

			) BDO
ON P.BusinessDevelopmentOfficer = BDO.ESS_USER_ID

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/IEP_Job_Seeker_20.original_load:
[IEP_Job_Seeker]:
    SELECT
    	'31/03/2024'									as [IEP Job Seeker Snapshot Date],
        EXTRACT_DATE										as [IEP Job Seeker Extract Date],
        CONVERT(VARCHAR,JOB_SEEKER_ID) + '|'
        	+ '31/03/2024'								as [IEP Job Seeker Key],
        JOB_SEEKER_ID										as [IEP Job Seeker ID],
        CRN													as [Job Seeker CRN],
        TITLE + ' ' + GIVEN_NAME + ' ' + SURNAME			AS [Job Seeker Name],
        SECOND_GIVEN_NAME 									as [Job Seeker Other Given Name],
        GENDER_CD 											as [Job Seeker Gender Code],
        CASE
        	WHEN JS.GENDER_CD = 'F' THEN 'Female'
            WHEN JS.GENDER_CD = 'M' THEN 'Male'
        END													as [Job Seeker Gender],
        BIRTH_DATE											as [Job Seeker Birth Date],
        COUNTRY_BIRTH_CD									as [Job Seeker Country Of Birth Code],
        COUNTRY_BIRTH										as [Job Seeker Country Of Birth],
        //AustralianCitizenFlag
        HOME_STATE											as [Job Seeker Home State],
        HOME_PC												as [Job Seeker Home Post],
        HOME_SUBURB											as [Job Seeker Home Suburb]
	FROM ESS.SUB814_JOBSEEKER_NIAA JS
    Where JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerID
    							FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA
                                WHERE '2024-03-31' BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND EFFECTIVE_END_DATE)
    AND '2024-03-31' BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/IEP_Locations_202.original_load:
[IEP_Locations]:
SELECT distinct
[IEP Activity Key]
,[IEP Activity Snapshot Date]
,[IEP Activity Extract Date]
,[IEP Activity Id]
,STRING_AGG(TRIM(CONVERT(varchar(max),Locations.[Locality IEP])), ', ') AS Locality_IEP
,STRING_AGG(TRIM(CONVERT(varchar(max),Locations.Electorate)),',') as Electorate
,STRING_AGG(TRIM(CONVERT(varchar(max),Locations.[Regions IEP])),',') as Regions_IEP
FROM
(
SELECT  
  	CONVERT(VARCHAR,L.ProjectId) + '|'
    	+ '31/03/2024'						    AS [IEP Activity Key]
     ,'31/03/2024'								AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date]
	 ,L.EXTRACT_DATE			    				AS [IEP Activity Extract Date]
	 ,[ProjectId]									as [IEP Activity Id]
     ,[RegionTypeCode]
     ,LOC.LONG_DESC 								AS [Locality IEP]
     ,FEL.LONG_DESC 								AS [Electorate]
     ,LMROLD.LONG_DESC 								AS [Regions IEP]
  FROM ESS.SUB805_IEP_PROJECT_LOCATION_HISTORY_NIAA L
  LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA LOC
       ON L.RegionCode = LOC.CODE
       AND LOC.FK_CDT_CODE = 'LOC'
  LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA FEL
       ON L.RegionCode = FEL.CODE
       AND FEL.FK_CDT_CODE = 'FEL'
  LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA LMROLD
       ON TRIM(L.RegionCode) = TRIM(LMROLD.CODE)
       AND LMROLD.FK_CDT_CODE = 'LMR'
  WHERE '2024-03-31' BETWEEN L.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND L.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
  AND L.RegionTypeCode IN ('LMROLD','LOC','FEL')

  )locations
group by 
[IEP Activity Key]
,[IEP Activity Snapshot Date]
,[IEP Activity Extract Date]
,[IEP Activity Id]

LEFT JOIN([IEP_Placement])
SQL
SELECT
	[IEP Placement Key],
    [Placement Final Milestone Date],
	[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
	[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
	[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week],
	CASE WHEN [Placement Max Paid Outcome Week] >= 26
	THEN 'Y'
	ELSE 'N' END AS [Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
	[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
FROM
(
SELECT 
[IEP Placement Key],
 MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
 MAX([Placement Paid Outcome Week])	   AS [Placement Max Paid Outcome Week],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
 MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
 
 from
 (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    + '31/03/2024'							AS [IEP Placement Key],   
	CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,OC.Week,COALESCE(PP.commencementDate,PP.Enddate)) AS DATE) as MilestoneDate,
   CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 
	    CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,13,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
		ELSE NULL END AS [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 
	    CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,26,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
		ELSE NULL END AS [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
	OC.Week				AS [Placement Paid Outcome Week],
	CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN      --- ANYTHING GREATER THAN 26 WEEKS IS COUNTED AS 26 WEEKS.
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=52 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone],
	CASE WHEN OC.Week>=104 THEN 
	    1
		ELSE 0 END AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   
  
inner JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG  
ON P.ProjectId=PG.ProjectID   
AND  '2024-03-31'  BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE 

inner JOIN  ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP  
ON PP.PlacementGroupId=PG.PlacementGroupID
AND PP.ProjectId=P.ProjectId
AND  '2024-03-31'  BETWEEN PP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE    

left JOIN ESS.SUB810_IEP_OUTCOME_HISTORY_NIAA OC
ON PP.ProjectPlacementID=OC.ProjectPlacementID
AND  '2024-03-31'  between OC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE and OC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

WHERE    
P.[ProgramCategoryCode]='A20'    
and oc.ClaimID IS NOT NULL
  AND oc.Claimdate IS NOT NULL
  AND OC.Week >= 13 
  AND OC.StatusCode in ('AC','VR')
  AND OC.ClaimStatusCode IN ('APPR','ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU')
  AND PP.PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
AND  '2024-03-31'  BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE  
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  --// data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.
 )
 a
GROUP BY [IEP Placement Key]
 )B

SELECT DISTINCT
    '31/03/2024'									AS [IEP Placement Snapshot Date],
	PP.EXTRACT_DATE										AS [IEP Placement Extract Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    	+ '31/03/2024'								AS [IEP Placement Key],
    PP.ProjectPlacementId								AS [IEP Placement ID],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectId) + '|'
    	+ '31/03/2024'								AS [IEP Activity Key],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobSeekerId) + '|'
    	+ '31/03/2024'								AS [IEP Job Seeker Key],
    PP.CreatedOn										AS [Placement Creation Date],
    CommencementDate									AS [Placement Start Date],
    CASE WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
		      CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
			  ELSE  
			  CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			  END AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],
    PlacementDescription								AS [Placement Description],
    EmployerABN											AS [Placement Employer ABN],
    NotionalFullTime									AS [Placement Notional Full Time],
    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 'true' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],
    Locality											AS [Placement Locality],
    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     THEN 1
     ELSE 0 END  AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
     COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
     CASE WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T') 
	   THEN 1 
	   ELSE 0 
	   END AS [Placement Training Commencements],
     CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	 CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2024-03-31' THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2024-03-31' 
             OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2024-03-31'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         END  
			 ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
     CASE WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01' 
	      THEN 'Y' 
		  ELSE 'N'
		  END AS [IAS Placement Flag],
          
		CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-03-31') THEN  --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-03-31') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2024-03-31')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 THEN PP.JobSeekerId
					 ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         END  
			 ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as [Placement Active As of Prev Period]   -- as of same date previous year,
       ,COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') as [Placement Result Desc]
// 	   ,[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week]
// 	   ,[Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome]
// 	   ,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]
// 	   ,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]
// 	   ,[Placement Final Milestone Date]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
// 	   ,[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]
FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG
ON PP.PlacementGroupId = PG.PlacementGroupId
AND '2024-03-31' BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P
ON PP.ProjectId=P.ProjectId
AND '2024-03-31' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA PGS
ON PG.CategoryCode = PGS.CODE
AND PGS.FK_CDT_CODE = 'PGS'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA IIN
ON PP.IndustryCode = IIN.CODE
AND IIN.FK_CDT_CODE = 'IIN'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJ
ON PP.OccupationCode = AZJ.CODE
AND AZJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA IINold
ON PP.IndustryCodeOld = IINold.CODE
AND IINold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'IIN'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJold

AND AZJold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YEP

AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  --// data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.

SELECT DISTINCT

    	+ '28/02/2025'								AS [IEP Activity Key],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobSeekerId) + '|'
    	+ '28/02/2025'								AS [IEP Job Seeker Key],
    PP.CreatedOn										AS [Placement Creation Date],
    CommencementDate									AS [Placement Start Date],
    CASE WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
		      CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
			  ELSE  
			  CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			  END AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],
    PlacementDescription								AS [Placement Description],
    EmployerABN											AS [Placement Employer ABN],
    NotionalFullTime									AS [Placement Notional Full Time],
    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 'true' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],
    Locality											AS [Placement Locality],
    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     THEN 1
     ELSE 0 END  AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
     COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
     CASE WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T') 
	   THEN 1 
	   ELSE 0 
	   END AS [Placement Training Commencements],
     CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	 CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2025-02-28' THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2025-02-28' 
             OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL

				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2025-02-28'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         END  
			 ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
     CASE WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01'

		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2025-02-28') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2025-02-28')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE

			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as [Placement Active As of Prev Period]   -- as of same date previous year,
       ,COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') as [Placement Result Desc]

// 	   ,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]

SELECT DISTINCT
    '30/04/2025'									AS [IEP Placement Snapshot Date],
	PP.EXTRACT_DATE										AS [IEP Placement Extract Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    	+ '30/04/2025'								AS [IEP Placement Key],
    PP.ProjectPlacementId								AS [IEP Placement ID],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectId) + '|'
    	+ '30/04/2025'								AS [IEP Activity Key],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobSeekerId) + '|'
    	+ '30/04/2025'								AS [IEP Job Seeker Key],
    PP.CreatedOn										AS [Placement Creation Date],
    CommencementDate									AS [Placement Start Date],
    CASE WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
		      CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
			  ELSE  
			  CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			  END AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],
    PlacementDescription								AS [Placement Description],
    EmployerABN											AS [Placement Employer ABN],
    NotionalFullTime									AS [Placement Notional Full Time],
    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 'true' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],
    Locality											AS [Placement Locality],
    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     THEN 1
     ELSE 0 END  AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')						AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
     COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')						AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
     CASE WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T') 
	   THEN 1 
	   ELSE 0 
	   END AS [Placement Training Commencements],
     CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	 CASE WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2025-04-30' THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2025-04-30' 
             OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2025-04-30'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         END  
			 ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
     CASE WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01'

		   CASE WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2025-04-30') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
				CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2025-04-30')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE

			END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
			END
         as [Placement Active As of Prev Period]   -- as of same date previous year,
       ,COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') as [Placement Result Desc]

// 	   ,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]

	,'17/08/2026'						as [CDP Job Seeker Snapshot Date]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '17/08/2026'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'

    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '17/08/2026'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Key]
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID]) + '|'
    	+ '17/08/2026'					AS [_CDP Job Seeker to JSCI Key]
	,JS.[JOB_SEEKER_ID] 						as [Job Seeker ID]
	,[CRN] 
	,[BIRTH_DATE]							as [Birth Date]
    ,JS.GENDER_CD							AS [Gender Code]
	,GDR.Long_Desc							as [Gender]
	,ISNULL([GIVEN_NAME] + ' ','')
    	+ [SURNAME]							as [Job Seeker Name]
	,[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD]				AS [Residential Community Code]
	,COALESCE(ccd.LONG_DESC,'UKN')			as [Residential Community]
	,[POSTAL_COMMUNITY_CD]					AS [Postal Community Code]
	,COALESCE(ccd_p.LONG_DESC,'UKN')		as [Postal Community]
    ,case
    	when (JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] is null or JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] = 'UNK') then COALESCE(ccd.LONG_DESC,'UKN')
    	else COALESCE(ccd_p.LONG_DESC,'UKN')
     end 									as [Job Seeker Community Name]

	,jsc.INDIGENOUS_IND 					AS [Indigenous Flag]
FROM [ESS].[SUB814_JOBSEEKER_NIAA] JS

LEFT JOIN ESS.DIM_GENDER GDR
  ON JS.GENDER_CD = GDR.GENDER_CD

LEFT JOIN ess.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ccd

LEFT JOIN ess.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA ccd_p

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB837_CDP_DEN_JS_CHARACTERISTICS_NIAA jsc

  AND '2026-08-17' BETWEEN jsc.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND jsc.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

where '2026-08-17' BETWEEN js.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND js.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSeekerId
						FROM ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA
