ESS/IEP/Temp/IEP_Activity_Expenditure.QV.original_load:
[IEP_Activity_Expenditure]:
SELECT
	[IEP Activity Key],
	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '17/08/2026'												AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '17/08/2026'								    				AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE														AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)										AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END																	AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END																	AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END																	AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END																	AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)

	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free,

	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free

	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE

			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')

	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId

LEFT JOIN ([IEP_Placement])
SQL
SELECT * 
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		[IEP Placement Key],
 		MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 		MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
 
 	from
    (
		SELECT 
 		CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    		+ '30/11/2021'							AS [IEP Placement Key],   
		CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,OC.Week,COALESCE(PP.commencementDate,PP.Enddate)) AS DATE) as MilestoneDate,
   		CASE
        	WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,13,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
			ELSE NULL END 													AS [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 
	        CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,26,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
            ELSE NULL END 													AS [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
		CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 1
			ELSE 0 END 														AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 1     --- ANYTHING GREATER THAN 26 WEEKS IS COUNTED AS 26 WEEKS.
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=52 THEN 1
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=104 THEN 1
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   
  
inner JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG  
ON P.ProjectId=PG.ProjectID   
AND  '2021-11-30'  BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE 

inner JOIN  ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP  
ON PP.PlacementGroupId=PG.PlacementGroupID
AND PP.ProjectId=P.ProjectId
AND  '2021-11-30'  BETWEEN PP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE    

left JOIN ESS.SUB810_IEP_OUTCOME_HISTORY_NIAA OC
ON PP.ProjectPlacementID=OC.ProjectPlacementID
AND  '2021-11-30'  between OC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE and OC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

WHERE    
P.[ProgramCategoryCode]='A20'    
and oc.ClaimID IS NOT NULL
  AND oc.Claimdate IS NOT NULL
  AND OC.Week >= 13 
  AND OC.StatusCode in ('AC','VR')
  AND OC.ClaimStatusCode IN ('APPR','ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU')
  AND PP.PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
AND  '2021-11-30'  BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE  
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  --// data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.
 )
 a
GROUP BY [IEP Placement Key]
 )B

        ELSE  
        	CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
    END 												AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],

    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],

    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     	WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     	THEN 1
     	ELSE 0
    END  												AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
    COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')					AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
    CASE
    	WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T')

	   	ELSE 0 
    END 												AS [Placement Training Commencements],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         											AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2021-11-30'
        	THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   		CASE
                	WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2021-11-30' 
             			OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             		THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
						CASE
                        	WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2021-11-30'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     		THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     		WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 		THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 		ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         	END  
			 		ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
				END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
            END											as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
    CASE
     	WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01' 
        THEN 'Y' 
        ELSE 'N'
  	END 												AS [IAS Placement Flag],
          
    CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2021-11-30')
        THEN  --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
			CASE
           		WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2021-11-30') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL
            	THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
					CASE
                		WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2021-11-30')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
                	END  
            	ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
		ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
	END													as [Placement Active As of Prev Period],   -- as of same date previous year,
    COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') 					as [Placement Result Desc]
	   --,[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week]
	   --,[Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome]
	   --,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Placement Final Milestone Date]

	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],
    PlacementDescription								AS [Placement Description],
    EmployerABN											AS [Placement Employer ABN],
    NotionalFullTime									AS [Placement Notional Full Time],
    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],
    Locality											AS [Placement Locality],
    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     	WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     	THEN 1
     	ELSE 0
    END  												AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
    COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')					AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
    CASE
    	WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T') 
	   	THEN 1 
	   	ELSE 0 
    END 												AS [Placement Training Commencements],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         											AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2021-12-31'
        	THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   		CASE
                	WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2021-12-31' 
             			OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             		THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
						CASE
                        	WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2021-12-31'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     		THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     		WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 		THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 		ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         	END  
			 		ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
				END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
            END											as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
    CASE
     	WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01' 
        THEN 'Y' 
        ELSE 'N'
  	END 												AS [IAS Placement Flag],
          
    CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2021-12-31')
        THEN  --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
			CASE
           		WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2021-12-31') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL
            	THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
					CASE
                		WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2021-12-31')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
                	END  
            	ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
		ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
	END													as [Placement Active As of Prev Period],   -- as of same date previous year,
    COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') 					as [Placement Result Desc]
	   --,[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week]
	   --,[Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome]
	   --,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Placement Final Milestone Date]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]
FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG
ON PP.PlacementGroupId = PG.PlacementGroupId
AND '2021-12-31' BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P
ON PP.ProjectId=P.ProjectId
AND '2021-12-31' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA PGS
ON PG.CategoryCode = PGS.CODE
AND PGS.FK_CDT_CODE = 'PGS'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA IIN
ON PP.IndustryCode = IIN.CODE
AND IIN.FK_CDT_CODE = 'IIN'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJ
ON PP.OccupationCode = AZJ.CODE
AND AZJ.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA IINold
ON PP.IndustryCodeOld = IINold.CODE
AND IINold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'IIN'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA AZJold
ON PP.OccupationCodeOld = AZJold.CODE
AND AZJold.FK_CDT_CODE = 'AZJ'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YEP
ON PP.EndReason = YEP.CODE
AND YEP.FK_CDT_CODE = 'YEP'

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA RRU
ON PP.PlacementResultCode = RRU.CODE
AND RRU.FK_CDT_CODE = 'RRU'

WHERE '2021-12-31' BETWEEN PP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
AND PP.PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X','T')
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  --// data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.

CDP Contract Referral Placement Row Counter
ESS/IEP/Snapshots/Temp/CDP_Contract_Refe.original_load:
[CDP_Contract_Referral_Placement]:
SELECT
distinct
*
,case
	when ROW_NUM = 1 and  [Contract Referral Placement Status] in ('Commenced','Suspended','Pending')
	then 'Yes'
	else 'No'
 end												as [Current Caseload Flag]
,'Yes'												as [Contract Placement Flag]
,1													as [CDP Contract Referral Placement Row Counter]
FROM (
SELECT


/* System dates */
CONVERT(VARCHAR,'30/09/2020',103)				as [CDP Contract Referral Placement Snapshot Date]  

/* Primary Key */

/* Association Keys */
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CRP.JobSeekerId) + '|' + 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,'30/09/2020',103)					as [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key]


/* Columns */
,CRP.JobSeekerId									as [Contract Referral Job Seeker ID]
,YSP.LONG_DESC										AS [Contract Referral Placement Status]


/* latest contract referral placement record ?? do we need this?  can a JS have two CRP = COM/SUS/PND at the same time?*/
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
	PARTITION BY CRP.ContractReferralPlacementId
	ORDER BY CRP.PlacementSequenceNumber DESC)		AS ROW_NUM 

FROM ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA CRP
LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB826_SITE_CONTRACT_NIAA AS SC ON SC.CONTRACT_ID = CRP.OutletContractId
AND CRP.OutletSequenceNumber = SC.CONTRACT_SEQUENCE
AND SC.CONTRACT_TYPE_CD = 'RJCP'
AND '2020-09-30' BETWEEN SC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND SC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YSP
ON CRP.StatusCode = YSP.CODE
AND YSP.FK_CDT_CODE = 'YSP'

WHERE '2020-09-30' BETWEEN CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE    AND CRP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
/* AND CRP.StatusCode <> 'TRN' ...Not sure about this - test */
AND CRP.PlacementTypeCode IN ('RCV','RFE') 
/*and (CRP.PlacementEndDate >= '2015-07-01' or CRP.PlacementEndDate = '0001-01-01')*/

)a

SQL

Select 

/* System dates */

		 JS.EXTRACT_DATE 					as [CDP Job Seeker Extract Date]
		,'30/09/2020' 			as [CDP Job Seeker Snapshot Date]  

		/* Primary Key */
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID) + '|' 
        	+ '30/09/2020' 		as [_CDP Job Seeker Key]

		/* Associative Key */
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID) + '|' 
        	+ '30/09/2020' 		as [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Placement Key]
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID) + '|' 
        	+ '30/09/2020' 		as [_CDP Job Seeker to Contract Referral Key]
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR,JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID) + '|' 
        	+ '30/09/2020' 		AS [_CDP Job Seeker to JSCI Key]

		,JS.JOB_SEEKER_ID					AS [Job Seeker ID]

		,JS.CRN 
		,JS.BIRTH_DATE						as [Birth Date]
		,JS.GENDER_CD						as [Gender Code]
        ,CASE
        	WHEN JS.[GENDER_CD] = 'M'
        	THEN 'Male'
        	WHEN JS.[GENDER_CD] = 'F'
        	THEN 'Female'
        	ELSE 'Other'
        END									as [Gender]
        ,JS.GIVEN_NAME + ' ' 
        	+ JS.SURNAME					AS [Job Seeker Name]
		,JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] 		as [Residential Community Code]
		,JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_NAME] 	as [Residential Community]
		,JS.[POSTAL_COMMUNITY_CD]  			as [Postal Community Code]
        ,JS.[POSTAL_COMMUNITY_NAME] 		as [Postal Community]
		,case
        	when (JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] is null
            	or JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_CD] = 'UNK')
            then JS.[POSTAL_COMMUNITY_NAME]
            else JS.[RESIDENTIAL_COMMUNITY_NAME]
         end 								as [Job Seeker Community Name]
		,JS_IND.INDIGENOUS_IND				AS [Indigenous Flag]

			
FROM (select distinct CRP.JobSeekerId/*--FK_CVF_JSKR_ID*/
		FROM ESS.SUB801_CDP_CRP_HISTORY_NIAA CRP/*--BICDS.VIEWCDS.VCNTRT_REF_PLCMNT CRP*/
		WHERE '2020-09-30' BETWEEN CRP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE  AND CRP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
		AND CRP.PlacementTypeCode IN ('RCV','RFE')/*--CRP.PLC_TYPE IN ('RCV','RFE') */
        ) DRIVER
LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB814_JOBSEEKER_NIAA as JS on DRIVER.JobSeekerId = js.JOB_SEEKER_ID
AND	'2020-09-30' BETWEEN JS.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND JS.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN (SELECT JOB_SEEKER_ID,INDIGENOUS_IND FROM ESS.vDEN_JS_CHARACTERISTICS
			WHERE '2020-09-30' BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
			UNION
			SELECT JOB_SEEKER_ID,INDIGENOUS_IND FROM ESS.vDEN_JS_CHAR_INDIGENOUS_IND
            WHERE '2020-09-30' BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
) AS JS_IND ON JS_IND.JOB_SEEKER_ID = DRIVER.JobSeekerId

SQL
SELECT
	[IEP Activity Key],
	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '30/09/2020'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END														AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA PYMT
ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
AND '2020-09-30' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

WHERE PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN')

)A

	[IEP Activity Key],

	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '30/09/2020'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END														AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P

	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '30/09/2020'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')

		ELSE 0

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)

        ELSE 0

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId

	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '31/12/2021'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '31/12/2021'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END														AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB803_IEP_PAYMENTS_NIAA PYMT
ON CAST(PYMT.SourcePaymentTypeId AS NUMERIC)=P.ProjectId
AND PYMT.ProgramCategoryCode='A20'
AND '2021-12-31' BETWEEN PYMT.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PYMT.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   

WHERE PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA','OPIR','FAPT','ISTA','ESTA','ISSA','ISTN') 
AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU','APPR','RECR','RCFU','RCPU')

AND PYMT.StatusDateTime IS NOT NULL
AND '2021-12-31' BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE   
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  /* data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.*/

)A

SELECT
	[IEP Activity Key],
	[IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	[IEP Activity Extract Date],
	[IEP Activity ID], 
	Payment_FY,  
	COALESCE(sum(Payments),0) as Expenditure,
	COALESCE(sum(Advance),0) as Advance,
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal),0) as Acquittal,
	COALESCE(sum(Payments_GST_Free),0) as Expenditure_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '28/02/2022'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '28/02/2022'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],
	P.EXTRACT_DATE											AS [IEP Activity Extract Date],
	CAST(P.ProjectId AS NUMERIC)							AS [IEP Activity ID]
	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */
	END														AS Payment_FY
    ,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
    END														AS Payments

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal

	,CASE WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstLiable,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance

	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0
        WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIA' THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
    END														AS Payments_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') 
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
        ELSE 0
    END														AS Acquittal_GST_Free
	,CASE
		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType IN ('OPIA')  
		THEN COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)
		ELSE 0 
	END														AS Advance_GST_Free
            
	,PYMT.StatusCode
	,PYMT.PaymentId
FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P

	COALESCE(sum(Advance_GST_Free),0) as Advance_GST_Free, 
	COALESCE(sum(Acquittal_GST_Free),0) as Acquittal_GST_Free
--INTO ESS.[IEP_Activity_Expenditure
from
(
SELECT 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,P.ProjectId) + '|'
		+ '28/02/2022'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    '28/02/2022'								    AS [IEP Activity Snapshot Date],

	,CASE
		WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) <= 6 THEN
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) ) /* 2016/2017 */
		ELSE
		CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) AS varchar(4) )
			+ '-' + CAST( YEAR(COALESCE(pymt.Duedate,PYMT.StatusDateTime)) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) /* 2017/2018 */

        ELSE 0

		WHEN PYMT.PaymentType = 'OPIR' AND PYMT.StatusCode IN ('ARQD','ACQU') THEN 0

        ELSE COALESCE(PYMT.AmountGstFree,0)

	,CASE

[IEP_Outcome]:
SELECT
    '30/09/2020'								AS [IEP Outcome Snapshot Date],
	OC.EXTRACT_DATE										AS [IEP Outcome Extract Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,OutcomeID) + '|'
    + '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Outcome Key],
    OutcomeID											AS [IEP Outcome ID],
    "Week"												AS [Outcome Week],
    DueDate												AS [Outcome Due Date],
    ClaimDate											AS [Outcome Claim Date],
    Amount												AS [Outcome Amount],
    CASE WHEN GstFree = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END			AS [Outcome Gst Free],
    CASE WHEN GstFree = 0 THEN Amount/1.1 ELSE Amount END
    													AS [Outcome Gst Excl Amount],
    CASE WHEN GstFree = 0 THEN Amount/11 ELSE Amount END
    													AS [Outcome Gst Amount],
    StatusCode											AS [Outcome Status Code],
    YYS.LONG_DESC										AS [Outcome Status],
    "Comment"											AS [Outcome Comment],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,ClaimID) + '|'
    + '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Claim Key],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,OC.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    + '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Placement Key],
    ClaimSequenceNumber									AS [Outcome Claim Sequence Number],
    ClaimStatusCode										AS [Outcome Claim Status Code],
    YPY.LONG_DESC										AS [Outcome Claim Status],
    ClaimStatusDate										AS [Outcome Claim Status Date]
FROM ESS.SUB810_IEP_OUTCOME_HISTORY_NIAA OC

LEFT JOIN ESS.SUB811_LOOKUP_ADW_CODE_NIAA YYS
ON OC.StatusCode = YYS.CODE

LEFT JOIN ([IEP_Placement])
SQL
SELECT * 
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		[IEP Placement Key],
 		MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 		MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
 
 	from
    (
		SELECT 
 		CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    		+ '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Placement Key],   
		CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,OC.Week,COALESCE(PP.commencementDate,PP.Enddate)) AS DATE) as MilestoneDate,
   		CASE
        	WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,13,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
			ELSE NULL END 													AS [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 
	        CAST(DATEADD(WEEK,26,PP.commencementDate) AS DATE)
            ELSE NULL END 													AS [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],
		CASE WHEN  OC.Week>=13 THEN 1
			ELSE 0 END 														AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=26 THEN 1     --- ANYTHING GREATER THAN 26 WEEKS IS COUNTED AS 26 WEEKS.
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=52 THEN 1
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone],
		CASE WHEN OC.Week>=104 THEN 1
        ELSE 0 END 															AS [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]

FROM ESS.SUB804_IEP_PROJECT_HISTORY_NIAA P   
  
inner JOIN ESS.SUB808_IEP_PLACEMENT_GROUP_HISTORY_NIAA PG  
ON P.ProjectId=PG.ProjectID   
AND  '2020-09-30'  BETWEEN PG.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PG.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE 

inner JOIN  ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP  
ON PP.PlacementGroupId=PG.PlacementGroupID
AND PP.ProjectId=P.ProjectId
AND  '2020-09-30'  BETWEEN PP.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND PP.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE    

left JOIN ESS.SUB810_IEP_OUTCOME_HISTORY_NIAA OC
ON PP.ProjectPlacementID=OC.ProjectPlacementID
AND  '2020-09-30'  between OC.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE and OC.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE

WHERE    
P.[ProgramCategoryCode]='A20'    
and oc.ClaimID IS NOT NULL
  AND oc.Claimdate IS NOT NULL
  AND OC.Week >= 13 
  AND OC.StatusCode in ('AC','VR')
  AND OC.ClaimStatusCode IN ('APPR','ACQU','ARQD','CONF','PEND','PNDU')
  AND PP.PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
AND  '2020-09-30'  BETWEEN P.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND P.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE  
AND P.ProjectId NOT IN (23054052,1882782)  --// data fix - eliminate these two EPI activities - till permanent fix.
 )
 a
GROUP BY [IEP Placement Key]
 )B
WHERE [Placement Final Milestone Date] IS NOT NULL || [IEP_Placement]:
SQL
SELECT DISTINCT
    '30/09/2020'								AS [IEP Placement Snapshot Date],
	PP.EXTRACT_DATE										AS [IEP Placement Extract Date],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectPlacementId) + '|'
    + '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Placement Key],
    PP.ProjectPlacementId								AS [IEP Placement ID],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,PP.ProjectId) + '|'
    + '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Activity Key],
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobSeekerId) + '|'
    + '30/09/2020'							AS [IEP Job Seeker Key],
    PP.CreatedOn										AS [Placement Creation Date],
    CommencementDate									AS [Placement Start Date],
    CASE 
    	WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
			CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
        ELSE  
        	CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
    END 												AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],
    PlacementDescription								AS [Placement Description],
    EmployerABN											AS [Placement Employer ABN],
    NotionalFullTime									AS [Placement Notional Full Time],
    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],
    Locality											AS [Placement Locality],
    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],
    ExpectedEndDate										AS [Placement Expected End Date],
    
    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],
    CategoryCode										AS [Placement Type Code],
    PGS.LONG_DESC										AS [Placement Type],
    CASE 
     	WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')
     	THEN 1
     	ELSE 0
    END  												AS [Employment Commenced],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Industry Desc],
    COALESCE(COALESCE(AZJ.LONG_DESC,AZJold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')
    													AS [Placement Occupation Desc],
    COALESCE(YEP.LONG_DESC,'Unknown')					AS [Placement End Rsn Desc],
    CASE
    	WHEN PP.PlacementResultCode in ('T') 
	   	THEN 1 
	   	ELSE 0 
    END 												AS [Placement Training Commencements],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         											AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2020-09-30'
        	THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   		CASE
                	WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2020-09-30' 
             			OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL 
             		THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
						CASE
                        	WHEN PP.EndDate >  '2020-09-30'   --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
				     		THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                     		WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
					 		THEN  PP.JobSeekerId
					 		ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
			         	END  
			 		ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
				END
			ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
            END											as  [Placement Active As of Snapshot Date],
    CASE
     	WHEN P.EndDate >='2014-07-01' 
        THEN 'Y' 
        ELSE 'N'
  	END 												AS [IAS Placement Flag],
          
    CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <= DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2020-09-30')
        THEN  --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
			CASE
           		WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2020-09-30') OR PP.ExpectedEndDate IS NULL
            	THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
					CASE
                		WHEN PP.EndDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1,  '2020-09-30')    --- MAKE SURE THE PLACEMENT DIDNT END EARLIER. END DATE AFTER REPORTING DATE. SO ACTIVE AS OF REPORTING DATE
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	WHEN PP.EndDate IS NULL   --NO END DATE. So, Placement not closed - So, active. 
                    	THEN PP.JobSeekerId
                    	ELSE 0             -- ENDED earlier. So, not active
                	END  
            	ELSE 0    ---Expected milestone end earlier than reporting date. so, not active.
			END
		ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
	END													as [Placement Active As of Prev Period],   -- as of same date previous year,
    COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') 					as [Placement Result Desc]
	   --,[Placement Max Paid Outcome Week]
	   --,[Placement Achieved 26 Week Outcome]
	   --,[Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]
	   --,[Placement Final Milestone Date]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 26 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 52 Week Milestone]
	   --,[Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]
FROM ESS.SUB806_IEP_PROJECT_PLACEMENT_HISTORY_NIAA PP

        ELSE  
        	CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
    END 												AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],

    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],

                	END

			END
		ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
	END													as [Placement Active As of Prev Period],   -- as of same date previous year,
    COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') 					as [Placement Result Desc]

	   --,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]

    '30/09/2020'								AS [IEP Placement Snapshot Date],

    	WHEN MONTH(CommencementDate) <= 6 THEN     
			CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) - 1 AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) )   
        ELSE  
        	CAST(YEAR(CommencementDate) AS varchar(4) ) + '-' + CAST( YEAR(CommencementDate) + 1 AS varchar(4) ) 
    END 												AS Commencement_FY   ,
    PP.EndDate											AS [Placement End Date],
    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate > '1950-01-01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS [Placement Closed Flag],
    PlacementSiteCode									AS [Placement Site Code],
    EndReason											AS [Placement End Reason],
    EndComment											AS [Placement End Comment],
    PlacementResultCode									AS [Placement Result Code],
    PlacementComment									AS [Placement Comment],
    PP.OccupationCode									AS [Placement Occupation Code],
    PP.IndustryCode										AS [Placement Industry Code],
    Location											AS [Placement Location],
    PostCode											AS [Placement Postcode],
    EmploymentSector									AS [Placement Employment Sector],
    EmploymentStatus									AS [Placement Employment Status],

    AssistanceTypeCode									AS [Placement Assistance Type Code],
    CDPClassification									AS [Placement CDP Classification],
    CASE WHEN SubstituteFlag = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS [Placement Substitute Flag],

    COALESCE(State,'Missing')							AS [Placement State],

    Name												AS [Placement Group Name],

    CASE 
     	WHEN PlacementResultCode IN ('P','X')

     	ELSE 0

    COALESCE(COALESCE(IIN.LONG_DESC,IINold.LONG_DESC),'Unknown')

    CASE WHEN PP.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
	         											AS [Placement Has Actual End Date],
	CASE
    	WHEN pp.CommencementDate <=  '2020-09-30'
        	THEN     --- PLACEMENT COMMENCEMENT EARLIER THAN RPT DATE
		   		CASE
                	WHEN PP.ExpectedEndDate >  '2020-09-30'

             		THEN  -- EXPECTED MILESTONE END DATE GREATER THAN REPORT DATE. SO ACTIVE
						CASE

			END
		ELSE 0     -- commencement after reporting date. so not applicable.
	END													as [Placement Active As of Prev Period],   -- as of same date previous year,
    COALESCE(RRU.LONG_DESC,'Unknown') 					as [Placement Result Desc]

	   --,[Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]

	SELECT

 		MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 		MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],
 		MAX([Expected 26 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 26 Week Achieved Date],

FROM
(
	SELECT 
		[IEP Placement Key],
 		MAX(MilestoneDate) AS [Placement Final Milestone Date],
 		MAX([Expected 13 Week Achieved Date]) as [Expected 13 Week Achieved Date],

 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 104 Week Milestone],
 		MAX([Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone]) as [Placement Outcome Achieved 13 Week Milestone],
